caseName: Pacific Creosoting Co. v. United States
caseNameFull: Pacific Creosoting Company, in Error v. United States
summary: In error to the United States Circuit Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit.
attorneys: Mr. George E. de Steiguer for the plaintiff in error. The Attorney General, The Solicitor General and Mr. Assistant Attorney General Adkins for the defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for the want of jurisdiction. Anglo-Californian Bank v. United States, 175 U. S. 37; Macfadden v. United States, 213 U. S. 288, 294.
